items.claim: She has constant forward pressure and mixes it up to the body, turning it up in the third round.
items.quote: she has constant forward pressure the entire time. She mixes it up to the body and then she really starts to turn it up in that third round.

items.claim: Luciano is 6 years younger at 26 years old.
items.quote: She's only 26 years old, which means she's going to be 6 years younger here.

items.claim: Luciano is a very good striker who is also developing her ground game and grappling.
items.quote: She's a very good fighter and a very good striker as well. And she even showed in her last fight where, you know, she's working on the ground game as well.

items.claim: Luciano's lone UFC loss came to Sam Hughes in a very close fight.
items.quote: Luciano's lone loss came to in the UFC it came to Sam Hughes in a very close fight that really could have went either way.

items.claim: Luciano will likely have a height and reach advantage.
items.quote: She's going to have a height advantage here, probably has a reach advantage as well.

items.claim: Oban Elliott is on back-to-back losses coming into this fight.
items.quote: So he's on back-to-back losses and if he loses this fight, you know, that might be it for O bon Elliott

items.claim: Michael Oliveira walks opponents down, has great durability, and slowly breaks them.
items.quote: He walks you down like Michael Myers. He's made out of iron. You know, if you hit him, he's not going to react at the slightest bit.

items.claim: Nina Milosevic has good striking, fast and accurate hands, and some pop.
items.quote: She's good. She has good striking, fast, accurate hands. She has some pop on those hands as well.
